title: Unforgiven
starring: Clint Eastwood, Gene Hackman, Morgan Freeman, Richard Harris, Jaimz Woolvett
summary: Retired gunslinger William Munny reluctantly returns to his violent past when a group of prostitutes in Big Whiskey, Wyoming, offer a bounty for two cowboys who brutally attacked one of their own. Joined by his former partner Ned Logan and a young aspiring gunfighter, Munny sets out to collect the reward, bringing him into conflict with the town's ruthless sheriff, Little Bill Daggett.
